name: barbarian
lore:
Seek them where the map-ink fades and the wind howls with a predator’s hunger. The Barbarian is no mere wanderer; they are an apex element of the world’s harshest fringes—the frost-rimed peaks, the sunless mires, and the choking sands. They do not merely survive the wild; they embody its pitiless logic.

In behavior, they are governed by a rhythm older than law. While the scholar consults parchment, the Barbarian listens to the thrum of their own blood. Their "rage" is misnamed by the soft-handed; it is, in truth, a transcendental state—a shedding of the civilized veneer to tap into the raw, tectonic power of the earth. They value the scar over the medal and instinct over argument. To witness them in battle is to see the storm take form: beautiful, terrifying, and utterly indifferent to the frailty of bone.
